text:
Anya: quick thread — prepping a short account health + token-econ snapshot for Acadia Health ahead of their QBR. Can we get: 1) 30/60/90 day token trend, 2) forecast for next quarter (tokens + $), 3) any budget alerts or renewal risk, 4) enablement gaps to mention. Need by EOD.

Ravi: on it. pulling spend & credits now, will paste a tiny forecast.

Ravi: forecast snippet:
```sql
-- tokens per day (rolling 7d avg)
SELECT date, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM usage
WHERE account_id = 'acadia'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 90;
```

Ravi: short summary: last 30d avg = 1.2M tokens/day, 60d avg = 900k, 90d avg = 760k. Embeddings spikes on 3/9 and 3/18 (batch import). If trend holds, Q2 forecast ~ 110M tokens (±15%). Committed credits used: 58% (FinanceBot sent a billing alert earlier).

FinanceBot: alert: committed-credits for account 'acadia' currently at 58%. Next invoice threshold in ~21 days. Recommended: remind customer about reserved capacity / discount options.

Logan: tagging infra question — are those embed spikes from our side or customer retries? @ravi can you share top routes?

Ravi: top routes: `/v1/embeddings/batch` (~72% of spike), `/v1/chat/generate` (~20%). Looks like a one-off backfill + a dev loop. I can get per-endpoint token burn CSV.

Priya: notes from last enablement call with Acadia: they planned a data migration (explains batch) but worried about overages. They asked about per-route throttling and pre-bill alerts. Also flagged a docs gap for embedding pagination examples.

Anya: OK — action items:
- Ravi: share forecast CSV + per-route burn by EOD. (include 30/60/90 metrics)
- Logan: propose a throttle suggestion and a simple pre-bill webhook pattern (small snippet).
- Priya: draft the enablement note for embedding pagination and migration best-practices, include one screenshot and short checklist.
- Me (Anya): add renewal-risk tag if forecast > 125% of committed credits and open a renewal touchpoint 6 weeks out.

Logan: quick throttle pattern (for the thread) — can paste as code: 
```yaml
# simple client-side burst limiter
max_requests_per_minute: 200
burst_capacity: 1000
# server-side: enable prefix caching for repeated batch calls
```

Priya: I can own the doc draft, will ping design for the screenshot.

Ravi: uploaded CSV to the shared folder: https://redwood.internal/s/acadia/usage_forecast.csv — also adding a short note on assumptions (no new features, includes scheduled backfill).

Anya: perfect. Also flagging: ask CS to propose a one-time credits top-up play (marketing can offer a small delta) — could smooth renewal.

deploy-bot: deploy complete: `release/acadia-qbr-prep` -> production (1 service updated).

Anya: thanks everyone — I'll stitch these into a 1-page QBR slide and share a draft in #customer-success by 3pm. :thumbsup:
